Dustline

A carbine that keeps firing when the wind kicks up

Dustline is built for open sand and long days. Scroll to turn it over.

650 rounds a minute

Quick enough to win a close fight, steady enough to hold a line.

400 metres of reach

Look straight down the barrel. Damage stays full out to four hundred metres before it falls off.

30 rounds in the magazine

From above you can see the receiver and feed. A full reload takes 2.1 seconds.

3.4 kilograms, carried low

The stock and grip sit tight to the shoulder, so recoil rolls straight back instead of climbing.
